svg.text: The one metric, per player, against his own no-skill rate

Each dot is one player. X is the share of his games in his largest cluster (what a predictor with no information scores). Y is the model landing in the actual cluster. Below the line means the model lost to doing nothing.
Top row: the 30 players whose clusters are usable categories. Third panel: the same test on the 128 players split by humps alone, as the robustness line.
player no-skill rate - 4 of 30 above their own line
player no-skill rate - 6 of 30 above their own line
player no-skill rate - 23 of 128 above their own line
Precision: consistently off by a little, then consistently off by a lot
blue: the offset added to every projection for that player (negative = the model projects above the actual).
red: the middle half of his residuals around that offset (spread).
median offset -3.17 points, median spread 12.84 points.
